# place type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:placeType`](gmeow-placeType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/placeType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The kind(s) of a place (one or more [`gmeow:PlaceType`](../classes/gmeow-PlaceType.md) individuals). Non-functional: multi-source classifications may differ (a place that is both 'city' and 'administrative area') and must coexist as evidence.
